notes: Only six pharmaceutical event-site observations from three storms, selected through public reporting. No industrial domain transfer or synthetic labels.
The unobserved population denominator and selective reporting prevent interpreting fitted probabilities as population outage rates.
Four positives and two nonfailures do not establish six independent hazard effects. Strong expert priors dominate poorly supported directions.
Repeated sites, shared companies, and storm-wide utility failures violate independent-site assumptions; leave-one-storm-out scores and event-balanced sensitivity expose part of this limit.
Operating means explicit company confirmation; a planned precautionary shutdown with confirmed restart and no serious impact is a nonfailure for material disruption, not zero downtime.
Site production disruption is distinct from national shortage or patient supply. Amgen is positive despite uninterrupted patient supply.
Wind, rainfall and tornado covariates are retrospective engine reconstructions from HURDAT2, conditional on default shear/soil/structure and coarse topography; not observed site weather.
Current map flood zones/river geometry and approximate site points may differ from historical parcel conditions. Unknown GIS coverage never becomes a non-SFHA control.
Rocky Mount 2023 has a verified outage but no compatible tropical-cyclone tornado covariate. It is excluded; direct EF3 intensity is not the engine tornado probability.
Existing rainRiver prior cites North Cove/Helene: leave-one-storm-out removes likelihood rows but not prior event knowledge. Scores are not independent validation.
No operational calibration claim, validated false-alarm rate, causal hazard coefficient, or recovery-duration fit is supported.

training.method: Bernoulli logistic likelihood + independent normal expert priors; elliptical slice MCMC

diagnostics.method: conventional split R-hat and initial-positive-pair autocorrelation ESS; diagnostics do not establish calibration

training.sampleOrder: seeded shuffle of joint draws from four chains

labelDefinition.target: Material weather-related site production disruption beyond precautionary closure alone
labelDefinition.positive: Explicit weather-caused stopped or reduced normal manufacturing with actual impairment/recovery; a later limited restart does not erase disruption.
labelDefinition.negative: Explicit company confirmation of unaffected/normal site operation, or a completed planned restart plus no serious impact. Negative is not a claim of zero downtime.
labelDefinition.precautionary: Planned closure alone is not a positive. A promised restart is not a negative. Ambiguous completed restarts remain censored.
labelDefinition.censored: Unknown post-event outcome, pre-event plans, unspecified recovery severity, or incompatible/missing hazard inputs never become operating controls.
labelDefinition.timeHorizon: Event-associated material interruption reported in dated primary follow-ups; no uniform hour/day threshold can be identified. Do not interpret this as any shutdown, outage >72h, or a national shortage label.

validation.scheme: leave-one-whole-storm-out likelihood diagnostics; fixed priors and feature transforms; no hyperparameter tuning
validation.priorKnowledgeCaveat: The existing rainRiver prior explicitly cites North Cove/Helene. Removing held-out likelihood rows does not remove this prior event knowledge. These scores are conditional diagnostics, not independent generalization estimates.

validation.identification: Six effects are not empirically established by three storms. Priors make the posterior proper; this is an evidence update, not operational calibration.

eventBalanced.interpretation: Power likelihood: each storm has total weight one; not the primary Bernoulli posterior.
